chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Muḥammad ibn al-Fuḍayl, from Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him, “Can the earth remain without an Imam?” He said, “No.”

I said, “For we narrate from Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام that it does not remain without an Imam unless Allah, Exalted is He, becomes wrathful against the people of the earth, or against the servants.”
So he said, “No, no; it would not remain. In that case, it would collapse.”

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbd Allāh, referring to Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.إِمَامٍ: the Imam, the divinely designated authority and proof over creation
key_terms.الْأَرْضُ: the earth, as the inhabited world whose order depends on divine authority
key_terms.لَسَاخَتْ: it would collapse or sink in, meaning the earth would not remain stable
key_terms.يَسْخَطَ: to become wrathful, referring to divine anger against people

ai.seo_question: Can the earth remain without an Imam according to Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith affirms that the earth cannot remain without an Imam, indicating the perpetual necessity of a Divine Authority among creation. It emphasizes that the continued stability of the earth is tied to the presence of the Imam, highlighting the doctrinal importance of Imamate in the divine order.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘
I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Can the earth remain without an Imam<sup>asws</sup>?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No’.

I said, ‘But we are reporting from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> that it would not remain without an Imam<sup>asws</sup> except that it would bog down upon the inhabitants of the earth, or upon the servants’.
So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No. It would not remain when it bogs down (its inhabitants)’.
en.sarwar: 11. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘isa from Muhammad al-Fudayl who has said the following. “I asked abu al-Hassan al-Rida (a.s.),
‘Can the remain without Imam?’” He replied, “No, it will not remain so.”
I then said, “We narrate from Imam abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) that the earth will not remain without Imam unless Allah becomes extremely angry with the people of the earth or with His servants.”
The Imam (a.s.) said, “In such condition it will not remain but it would obliterate with its inhabitants.”
